description: This file contains TypeScript code for generating, processing, and managing configuration documentation baselines, including schema parsing, deduplication, artifact rendering, and file operations within a project.

methods.name: collectConfigDocBaselineEntries
methods.description: Recursively collects configuration baseline entries from a JSON schema, considering UI hints and schema properties.

methods.name: dedupeConfigDocBaselineEntries
methods.description: Deduplicates configuration baseline entries by merging entries with the same path.

methods.name: splitConfigDocBaselineEntries
methods.description: Splits entries into core, channel, and plugin categories based on their kind.

methods.name: flattenConfigDocBaselineEntries
methods.description: Flattens a baseline object into a list of all entries.

methods.name: buildConfigDocBaseline
methods.description: Builds the complete configuration documentation baseline by loading schema, collecting entries, and deduplicating.

methods.name: renderConfigDocBaselineArtifacts
methods.description: Renders the baseline into JSON artifacts for different categories.

methods.name: computeConfigBaselineHashFileContent
methods.description: Generates hash file content for configuration baseline artifacts.

methods.name: writeConfigDocBaselineArtifacts
methods.description: Writes baseline artifacts and hash files to disk, with optional check mode.

methods.name: getNormalizedFieldHelp
methods.description: Returns a record of normalized field help paths mapped to their help text.
